title: Splitting a no-charge work order keeps No Charge with $0.00 shop supplies
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a Min shop supplies charge of $15.00.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category Comeback, in status Approved, with two approved lines.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Split work order 1, moving its second line to a new work order.
  3. Open the new work order.
  4. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  5. Click "Change category".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • A new work order is created.

Step 3:

  • It shows the "No Charge" badge.
  • "Shop supplies" reads $0.00.
  • The moved line shows cost and hours and no price, and no fee or discount was added.

Step 4:

  • The menu shows "Change category".

Step 5:

  • The window shows Comeback.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-E2: “If a work order is split, each part keeps the classification of the original and, on a no-charge work order, its category; the new work order starts with Shop supplies $0.00 and gets no automatic fees or discounts (S2-R15); lines move with cost and hours and no prices.”
